$comment: What a page's own navigator can declare: a product token at the start of navigator.userAgent; a product token anywhere in it, matched as a versioned token (Name/version, contract section 6), for an agent's in-app browser whose user agent is its app's default; or a navigator.platform that names a hosting runtime. Each user-agent token here is also in tokens.json with the same name, so both halves agree.
